name: Dr. Moopen’s Medical College Hospital (DM WIMS / DM Wayanad Institute of Medical Sciences)
tagline: Meppadi’s tertiary referral medical college hospital and major accredited surgical centre
summary: Medical college hospital in Meppadi serving as Wayanad’s principal tertiary referral centre; NABH-listed scope includes wide surgical and speciality services and an NABL-accredited central laboratory.
description: Dr. Moopen’s Medical College Hospital (also known as DM WIMS) is a medical college hospital located at Naseera Nagar, Meppadi (Wayanad). It was established by the DM Education and Research Foundation and forms the clinical and teaching hub for Dr. Moopen’s allied colleges.

The hospital appears on the NABH accredited list with an extensive scope of clinical and diagnostic services and a sanctioned bed strength of 798, making it the district’s main tertiary referral facility and an important surgical centre for Wayanad. Its campus also hosts nursing, pharmacy and allied health training linked to the college.

The hospital’s laboratory is NABL‑accredited and the campus promotes clinical research and training facilities (molecular biology, virology and cell‑culture labs). The hospital is empanelled under national/state health schemes for cashless care; for any referral or credential checks confirm current accreditation and empanelment before transfer.
highlights: Wide specialty coverage including neurosurgery, urology, medical oncology and critical care (NABH scope).
Teaching hospital for DM WIMS medical, nursing and pharmacy colleges.
Empanelled for national/state schemes (listed for PM‑JAY / Ayushman Bharat).

sections.heading: Background
body: Dr. Moopen’s Medical College Hospital (DM WIMS) is run by the DM Education and Research Foundation. The college and hospital cluster were developed to expand tertiary healthcare and medical education in Wayanad, a hilly and tribal district where advanced services were limited.

Local and corporate publications and the institution’s own materials describe it as among the few rural medical college hospitals in India to achieve NABH recognition (see sources). The district administration lists the college as the medical college for Wayanad.

sections.heading: Clinical services and role in Wayanad
body: The hospital’s NABH scope (published by NABH) lists a broad set of clinical departments and diagnostic services — general surgery, neurosurgery, urology, medical oncology, nephrology with dialysis, paediatrics and neonatal care, anaesthesiology, cardiology and full imaging services (CT, MRI, DSA/Cath lab etc.). This range supports its role as the main tertiary referral and surgical centre in the district.

Laboratory services include clinical biochemistry, microbiology, histopathology and molecular biology. The hospital’s central laboratory holds a NABL certificate (medical laboratory accreditation) indicating formal recognition of lab quality and competence.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Emergency services operate from the hospital campus; outpatient and specialist appointments are normally scheduled — contact the hospital before you travel. The district website and the hospital website give official contact and web details (confirm latest phone / email on the hospital site).

How to reach: the hospital is in Meppadi (Naseera Nagar). Meppadi lies roughly 10–15 km from the district town Kalpetta; the nearest major railhead and airport for most travellers is Kozhikode/Calicut (Calicut International Airport and Kozhikode railway station — road travel times vary). Use Kalpetta or Kozhikode as travel hubs and expect hilly, winding roads into Meppadi.

latest.text: NABH published scope lists DM WIMS Hospital certificate H-2016-0365 with validity shown through 2026-11-02; visitors and referrers should verify current NABH status on NABH before transfer/credentialing.

Listings checked in October 2026 show the hospital empanelled under Ayushman Bharat / PM‑JAY and other government health schemes for cashless care; confirm scheme coverage for the specific procedure before admission.
NABH scope document records that Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation was added to the hospital's accredited services on 2025-03-13.

NABL issued an ISO 15189 medical laboratory accreditation certificate (central laboratory) to Dr. Moopen’s Medical College central lab (Certificate MC-7191; validity shown until 2029-02-22 on the NABL record).

visitorInfo.bestTime: Open year‑round; emergency care is continuously available — call ahead for outpatient appointments and elective surgery scheduling.
visitorInfo.howToReach: By road: reach Meppadi (Naseera Nagar) from Kalpetta (the district town) by local bus or taxi — Meppadi is roughly 10–15 km from Kalpetta. The nearest major railhead and airport are at Kozhikode/Calicut (road travel to Meppadi takes around 1.5–2 hours depending on route and traffic).
etiquette: Verify current NABH accreditation and empanelment status before arranging transfers or insurance claims.
For cashless or scheme-covered care carry your Ayushman/PM‑JAY or ECHS card and ID; confirm the procedure is covered.
Call the hospital or email via the official contact page before travel to book specialist appointments or confirm bed availability.
Roads into Meppadi are hilly and winding; allow extra travel time in monsoon season and check local travel options from Kalpetta.
